shortDescription: By Tom PolansekThe US national average price of gasoline dropped below $4 per gallon for the first time since August 10, price tracker GasBuddy said on Sunday.

children: The US national average price of gasoline dropped below $4 per gallon for the first time since August 10, price tracker GasBuddy said on Sunday.
The average gasoline price was $3.998 per gallon and falling, while diesel prices were poised to slip below $6 per gallon soon, GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan posted ​on social media site X.

The declines were seasonal and due to oil prices dropping on optimism over a possible deal to end the US-led war on Iran, wrote De Haan, adding gas prices typically decline in autumn and rise in the spring.
